cyprus/paphos-archaeological.name: Paphos Archaeological Park and harbour
cyprus/paphos-archaeological.description: Roman villas with mosaics, a medieval fort and a harbour promenade, a UNESCO site.
cyprus/paphos-archaeological.details: Paphos Archaeological Park holds the House of Dionysos and other villas with well-preserved floor mosaics. The harbour has a small fort, restaurants and the Tombs of the Kings nearby. Visit in the morning to avoid the heat.

cyprus/akamas-blue-lagoon.name: Akamas Peninsula and Blue Lagoon
cyprus/akamas-blue-lagoon.description: A wild peninsula of gorges, coves and a turquoise bay reached by boat or 4x4.
cyprus/akamas-blue-lagoon.details: The Akamas is the wildest part of Cyprus. Boats from Latchi run to the Blue Lagoon for swimming and snorkelling, and a hike through the Avakas Gorge takes about an hour. Lara Beach is a nesting site for turtles. Take water and sun protection.

cyprus/kourion-petra-tou-romiou.name: Kourion and Aphrodite Rock
cyprus/kourion-petra-tou-romiou.description: A Greco-Roman hillside theatre and the legendary birthplace of Aphrodite on the coast.
cyprus/kourion-petra-tou-romiou.details: Kourion is a ruined city above the sea with a theatre still used for performances and mosaics. Petra tou Romiou, Aphrodite Rock, lies along the road toward Paphos. Both stops fit on the drive between Paphos and Limassol.

cyprus/limassol-old-town.name: Limassol old town and marina
cyprus/limassol-old-town.description: A seafront promenade, a castle museum and lively restaurants.
cyprus/limassol-old-town.details: Limassol has a rebuilt old town with narrow streets, Limassol Castle and the Molos promenade. The marina is a place for dinner. A wine tour to the Commandaria villages is a popular half-day.

cyprus/troodos-painted-churches.name: Troodos painted churches and villages
cyprus/troodos-painted-churches.description: Byzantine churches with frescoes in the pine mountains, a UNESCO group.
cyprus/troodos-painted-churches.details: The Troodos has ten painted churches, such as Agios Nikolaos tis Stegis and Panagia Forviotissa at Asinou. Mountain villages such as Omodos make wine and lace. The air is cooler than the coast, and winter may bring snow.

cyprus/troodos-hiking.name: Troodos nature trails and waterfalls
cyprus/troodos-hiking.description: Short hikes to the Caledonia and Millomeris waterfalls through forest.
cyprus/troodos-hiking.details: The Caledonia Trail is about three kilometres to a waterfall, with shaded paths and streams. The Troodos region is also known for its wineries. Wear proper footwear, as paths can be slippery.

cyprus/nicosia-old-town.name: Nicosia old town and the Green Line
cyprus/nicosia-old-town.description: The last divided capital in Europe, with Venetian walls and the UN buffer zone.
cyprus/nicosia-old-town.details: Nicosia old town sits inside Venetian walls and is divided by the UN Green Line. Visitors can cross at Ledra Street on foot. The Cyprus Museum, Famagusta Gate and the Laiki Geitonia district are highlights. Bring ID for the crossing.

cyprus/larnaca-salt-lake.name: Larnaca salt lake and Hala Sultan Tekke
cyprus/larnaca-salt-lake.description: A flamingo lake in winter and a mosque beside it, near the airport.
cyprus/larnaca-salt-lake.details: The Larnaca Salt Lake holds flamingos from about November to March, and the Hala Sultan Tekke is a peaceful mosque beside it. The promenade in town leads to the Church of Saint Lazarus. It is an easy last-day stop near the airport.

cyprus/cape-greco.name: Cape Greco and Ayia Napa sea caves
cyprus/cape-greco.description: A national forest park of cliffs, sea caves and swimming spots on the east coast.
cyprus/cape-greco.details: Cape Greco has walking trails above blue water, sea caves and cliff-jumping spots. The Ayia Napa and Protaras beaches lie nearby, with Nissi Beach known for lively summers. A boat trip to the sea caves is popular. Weekends can be crowded.

cyprus/troodos.name: Troodos
cyprus/troodos.description: A pine-covered mountain range of painted churches and wine villages.

cyprus/limassol.name: Limassol
cyprus/limassol.description: A lively seaside city with a castle, marina and wine tours.

cyprus/nicosia.name: Nicosia
cyprus/nicosia.description: The divided capital with Venetian walls and museums.

cyprus/larnaca.name: Larnaca
cyprus/larnaca.description: A beach town with a salt lake, close to the main international airport.
